codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly restores the two-column layout in PlanTrade.tsx by moving the Trade Details panel to a separate right-hand grid column, ensuring it is positioned laterally adjacent to the planner form on larger screens. The mode toggle and planner form remain appropriately positioned in the left column. The use of Tailwind grid classes (xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_420px]) ensures responsive behavior.
